name: Caspio REST API
description: Caspio REST API provides endless possibilities to extend the power of Caspio by integrating your account with other applications and services. Swagger UI allows you to visualize and interact with Caspio REST API before you start customizing your applications. To try out these operations with your Caspio account, follow the instructions outlined in Caspio’s help article: Web Services API.
